meta.source: NTCSA Transmission Development Plan 2024 (2025-2034), Public Report Rev2 (all nine provincial chapters) plus the TDP 2024 Public Forum presentation (corridor route lengths).
meta.coverage: All nine provinces, parsed from the full Public Report. Every project carries its own expected commercial-operation year and delivery phase as published.
meta.phase_note: Execution is committed and under way. Definition is in detailed design. Concept and Pre-Concept are indicative and likely to change. NTCSA states the first five years carry high certainty and beyond 2030 is more uncertain. The TDP is explicitly NOT an investment commitment.
meta.new_sites: Some endpoints are substations the TDP creates and which do not exist yet; their coordinates are approximated from the TDP’s descriptions.
meta.placed: 7,050 km of 765 kV corridors and 4,505 km of 400 kV lines carry route lengths.
meta.completeness: Route lengths by province and voltage are taken from the Public Report’s "Planned overhead lines" tables (line_km_by_province), which are the authoritative totals: 765 kV sums to exactly the published 6,957 km, and 400 kV to 7,186 of 7,477 km (96%). The 230 mapped projects show WHERE and WHEN the build happens; the provincial tables give the full kilometre picture, including shorter local strengthening not itemised as named projects.
